Criteria file read; criterion 3 present and matches the claim. readonly.py:45-85 first_sql_keyword tokenizes with sqlglot dialect tokenizer. MySQL tokenizer treats '#' as a comment start (sqlglot MySQL COMMENTS), so tokens begin with SELECT, a keyword whose KEYWORDS entry matches the token type (line 82), giving 'SELECT'. For postgres, sqlite and no dialect '#' is not a comment, so the first token is the HASH symbol; its text does not start with a letter or underscore and it is not VAR, so line 84 returns ''.
